description: IBGE BC series is a series of datasets listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). A classe Banco Areia que faz parte da categoria Hidrografia da Base Cartográfica Contínua do Brasil na escala 1:250 000 (BC250) sendo um conjunto de dados geoespaciais de referência, estruturados em bases de dados digitais, permitindo uma visão integrada do território nacional nesta escala. Coverage: Brasil. The portal lists 5 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its tags are BC250, base cartográfiica contínua, base vetorial, 1:250.000, Brasil. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
